card.text: Planet smaller than Earth of TRAPPIST-1, one year every 18.77 days.

introduction.text: TRAPPIST-1h is 0.76 Earth radii across and 0.33 Earth masses. It circles its star every 18.77 days at 0.062 au, receiving 0.14 times the sunlight Earth does.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the measured radius, lit by its star. No image, colour or map of this planet exists.

illustration.title: NASA artist's concept
illustration.summary: The map NASA's Eyes on Exoplanets wraps around this planet. None of it was observed, and its longitudes are arbitrary.
